brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by wind-blown debris, leaf litter, nesting material, and accumulated dust, as obstructed ventilation must be cleared before a forecast heat event in accordance with SOP-015. Additionally, maintain the minimum clearance of two metres between any growth and the radiator face and one metre between growth and the compound fence line as outlined in SOP-011. Since this unit has a known oil issue and advanced age with a history of high loading, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 if it cannot be attended before the event per MG-023.
